summary: Angry caller referenced prior bad service and requested a manager; agent did not transfer.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Summit Home Services, this is Alex.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your technician missed my window last time and nobody called me back. I want a manager.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can still help you book a new inspection if you'd like.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No. I'm upset. Transfer me to a person.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Tell me your address and we can get you on the calendar.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You're not listening. This is ridiculous.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. Are you a homeowner in our service area?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm done. I'll dispute the charge with my card company.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry you feel that way. Goodbye.
